Container.Name: hopwatch-probe
Container.Overview:
Hopwatch Probe pings your targets every second, keeps the history (every ping for days, minute and 5-minute averages for months) and runs MTR on demand or automatically when packet loss goes over a limit. MTR results come with a "Copy for support" text in the usual mtr report layout. Everything is set in the web UI; open it once to set the admin password.
Host network is recommended: MTR then shows your real first hop instead of the Docker bridge.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI. With host network this is the port on the server; if you change it, also change the WebUI link under Advanced.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, ping history and MTR results (about 250 MB a year for 50 targets).

Config.Name: Reset admin password
Config.Description: true removes the admin password at the next start, so you can set a new one in the web UI. Switch it back to false afterwards.
